rationale: Record a documentation-only correction to the native presentation endpoint contract and its matching skill note. Returning from GpuSurface::end_frame() is a submit-side event, not presentation, and the back-buffer readback runs earlier still, so both candidate timestamps under-report first-visible latency rather than overshooting it as the prior comment claimed. The change adds no producer, alters no rendering primitive, and touches no transferred Vellum slice; it forecloses an incorrect implementation of an endpoint Pulp already retains.
